steps.title: 1. Given Alice uses an isolated browser profile with the synthetic identity and permissions defined for this case
2. And the synthetic catalog uses exact tile titles "T-TRADE", "T-CASH", and "T-REPORT"
3. And T-TRADE requires entity "E-TRADE" and subject "S-VIEW"
4. And T-CASH requires entity "E-CASH" and subject "S-VIEW"
5. And T-REPORT permits entities "E-RR-A" and "E-RR-B" with an empty subject
6. And Alice has only entity "E-RR-B" in the controlled EMS2 response
7. And the controlled login deployment enables the local Username and Password form
8. When Alice fills the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" with "alice" on the Sign In page
9. And Alice fills the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" with the fixture password on the Sign In page
10. And Alice clicks the button labeled "Sign In" on the Sign In page
11. And Alice clicks the text "New Tile" on the portal workspace page
12. Then the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options" is visible on the portal workspace page
13. And the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options" contains exactly 1 occurrences of tile title text "T-REPORT"
14. And the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options" contains exactly 0 occurrences of tile title text "T-TRADE"
15. And the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options" contains exactly 0 occurrences of tile title text "T-CASH"
